description: Session-scoped Smart Router control, guardrails, and receipt validation.

hooks.command: router_base="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/smart-router"; router_link="$router_base/runtime-current"; release_base="$router_base/runtime-releases"; router_runtime="$router_link/hooks/router_hook.py"; plugin_runtime="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/hooks/router_hook.py"; router_target=$(readlink "$router_link" 2>/dev/null || true); router_suffix=${router_target#runtime-releases/}; release_root="$router_base/$router_target"; stable_ok=false; if [ "$router_target" = "runtime-releases/$router_suffix" ] && [ ${#router_suffix} -eq 20 ]; then case "$router_suffix" in *[!0-9a-f]*) ;; *) stable_ok=true ;; esac; fi; if [ "$stable_ok" = true ] && [ ! -L "$router_base" ] && [ ! -L "$release_base" ] && [ ! -L "$release_root" ] && [ -d "$release_root" ] && [ ! -L "$release_root/hooks" ] && [ -f "$router_runtime" ] && [ ! -L "$router_runtime" ]; then python3 "$router_runtime" session-start || exit 0; elif [ -n "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ] && [ -f "$plugin_runtime" ]; then python3 "$plugin_runtime" session-start || exit 0; else exit 0; fi
